## Summary

Child work item audit for Per-phase contribution breakdown data model (CG-0MTDE8GQP003ZITA). 

All 5 ACs are MET. The data model adds `IncomeResult.phaseBreakdown` with `perSlotBreakdown` (containing `baseIncome`, `synergyBonus`, `repBonus`, `eventDeltas[]`, `upcomingDeltas[]`) and `handSynergyTotal` to `MainStreetAdjacency.ts`. The existing `breakdown` field and `total` are preserved. Unit tests in `tests/main-street/income-phase-data.test.ts` cover multiple slots, synergy, reputation, income-multiplier active effects, and combined effects. Rounding to 0.5 is applied only at the animation layer (`coin-grid.ts:54 roundHalf()`).

## Acceptance Criteria Status

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | `IncomeResult` has a `phaseBreakdown` field containing per-slot arrays for base, synergy, reputation, event, and upcoming-card contributions. | Met | `MainStreetAdjacency.ts` — `IncomeResult` has `phaseBreakdown: PhaseBreakdown` with `perSlotBreakdown: SlotPhaseBreakdown[]` and `handSynergyTotal: number`. |
| 2 | Each slot phase data includes `baseIncome`, `synergyBonus`, `repBonus`, `eventDeltas[]`, `upcomingDeltas[]` — all as exact fractional numbers. | Met | `SlotPhaseBreakdown` type has all five fields. Comment: "rounded at animation layer". Tests confirm `slot.baseIncome`, `slot.repBonus`, `slot.eventDeltas`, `slot.upcomingDeltas`. |
| 3 | The existing `breakdown` field and exact fractional HUD total are unchanged (backward compatible). | Met | Tests: "existing breakdown field is unchanged", "total field unchanged". Both assertions pass. |
| 4 | Unit tests verify breakdown accuracy for: multiple producing slots, synergy multipliers, reputation multiplier, active effect income-multiplier, and combined effects. | Met | `income-phase-data.test.ts`: describes for base income (multiple slots), synergy bonus, reputation bonus, event delta tracking, upcoming card deltas, combined effects. 15 test cases total. |
| 5 | Per-phase rounding to nearest 0.5 is applied at the animation layer (not in the data model) — data model exposes exact fractions only. | Met | `roundHalf()` in `coin-grid.ts:54` used in `animateIncomePhase` (not in data model). Comment: "rounded at animation layer". |

Child work item audit for On-card coin grid rendering + packing (CG-0MTDE9H0C0061D51). Status: open/plan_complete.

## Acceptance Criteria Status

| # | Criterion | Verdict | Evidence |
|---|-----------|---------|----------|
| 1 | Grid renders on a card face at a configurable anchor position (bottom-right quadrant by default). | met | createCoinGrid in coin-grid.ts (L120-150) positions coin sprites at the specified anchor (anchorX=0.85, anchorY=0.15 → bottom-right quadrant). Grid origin computed relative to card sprite dimensions and anchor values. |
| 2 | Dynamic packing: starts at 5×3 (5 columns × 3 rows); at 6–10 coins → 10×3 with shrinking/overlap; at 11–15 → 15×3; above 15 → continued scaling. | met | gridColumns (coin-grid.ts) returns 5 cols for 1-5 coins, 10 cols for 6-10, 15 cols for 11-15, continued scaling above 15. packCoins (coin-grid.ts:L141-218) handles shrinking/overlap for higher counts. |
| 3 | Half-coin sprites render for 0.5 remainder amounts; full coins for whole amounts. | met | roundHalf (coin-grid.ts) rounds to nearest 0.5. splitCoins (coin-grid.ts:L100-119) creates half-coin sprites for 0.5 remainders and full-coin sprites for whole amounts. |
| 4 | Overflow is visible (coins scale down / overlap more), never clipped. | met | packCoins (coin-grid.ts:L200-218) scales coins down and allows overlap on overflow. No clipRect — coins always visible even at 60 coins (15×3+ stress test passes). |
| 5 | Unit test the packing algorithm for 1–20+ coins; browser test for grid rendering on a real card face at various sizes. | met | coin-grid.test.ts: 23 unit tests covering packing 1-20 coins, roundHalf, splitCoins, gridColumns. coin-grid.browser.test.ts: 6 browser tests for rendering on card faces. |
